digest.component_or_area: tickets-store git repository maintenance and reclaim
propositions: The tickets-store filtered git pack exceeds the CI Verified gate limit of 131072 KiB, blocking Gerrit landings for changes with stale bases.
Quiet-window coordinated history rewrite using git fast-export/filter/fast-import must strip unreachable .bridge_state history and reclaim approximately 1 GiB of disk space.
Prerequisite diagnostic repair ticket 30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a must complete with zero repairable diagnostics and exactly four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED records before history rewrite begins.
Off-repo bundles must be created before and after the repair step, verified independently, and retained as rollback artifacts; repack and gc must follow only after both bundles are validated.
Publication via exact --force-with-lease must preserve tree/commit/merge counts and identity multisets while ensuring old-tip is not reachable from any ref in a default clone.

Deterministic first post-rewrite writer vote must be the sole canonical review-artifact sequence (exactly CREATE, REVIEW_RESULT, and bidirectional links) with opportunistic enrichment disabled and prior setting restored.
